_comment: Publication classes of the monthly source files (D-023 point 1, D-026). Read by the monthly update engine (M11) and the pre-push scan (its monthly-class rules arrive in M11). Roles and folders follow docs/new-build/09-repository-and-docs-structure.md section 5 and docs/MONTHLY_UPDATE_GUIDE.md. A change here is a policy change: it needs the decision it rests on.

limits.aboveMax: commit the PDF; keep the original privately and record its SHA-256 in MANIFEST.json (D-023)

P.name: publishable
P.meaning: Every Accord Fintech file (the licence covers all Accord files, D-026), the other approved monthly source files of D-023 point 1, and Centricity material without client or personal data. Committed in its role folder of monthly_updates/YYYY-MM/ after the privacy scan.

C.name: private until approved
C.meaning: A source that is neither Accord nor Centricity material, or whose owner has not agreed. The raw file stays in private storage, proven by its SHA-256 in MANIFEST.json; data derived from it may be embedded where D-023 permits.

N.name: never
N.meaning: Client data, personal data, credentials, confidential client presentations and the MF Screener data pack (D-026). Never committed and never embedded in a public build; a client file found in a monthly folder is quarantined and reported.
